title: Feature Request: AI-powered Auto-Selection to replace manual brushing
summary: ### What are you trying to do? The current manual brush tool for inpainting or masking is very tedious and frustrating to use. Manually painting over complex subjects or specific objects takes a lot of time and often lacks precision, which significantly slows down the workflow. ### What would help It would be incredibly helpful to add an AI-powered auto-selection tool (e.g., "Select Subject" or "Select Object" with a single click/bounding box). Since many of us run this with capable and powerful GPUs, it makes sense to fully utilize that hardware power to run a fast segmentation model (like Segment Anything) automatically, rather than forcing users to rely on manual brushwork. ### Anything you tried instead _No response_
